sources.role: supplementary catalogue (Hexagonal Workbench), dated 2025/11 per its own back cover -- newer than E147's undated print
earlier incomplete extraction (326 rows, no EA/EB/ED), used only as a cross-check, superseded here
cross-checked for site's own variant axis values, esp. tool-cabinet drawer-code dropdowns

_meta.extraction_method: Every dimension/load/material/drawer-stack fact was read from a page image rendered from the PDF at 2.0-2.5x scale (PyMuPDF page.get_pixmap) and visually transcribed, with PyMuPDF word/x0/y0-coordinate extraction (page.get_text('words'), clustered by column x-range and sorted by y within each column) used to disambiguate which drawer-height figures belong to which SKU column wherever a page had multiple SKU cards side by side (this was essential on E147 p25 and p26, where naive get_text() scrambles column order). No fact below was interpolated or guessed; every non-null field cites a (source_pdf, page) pair, and every SKU code claimed to exist in the catalogue was confirmed with a full-text regex search of both PDFs.
hard_constraints_followed: No git commands were run; nothing was committed.
marketing/dedup-plan.md, marketing/rank1-research.md, marketing/poster-campaign.md were not touched.

drawer_code_verdict.hypothesis_tested: EA-<height/100 digits><drawer count, 2-digit zero-padded><config digit>, e.g. EA-10051 = H1000, 5 drawers, config 1
drawer_code_verdict.verdict: CONFIRMED for the digit-decoding formula itself; REFUTED as a claim that all 8 dropdown values per family are real catalogued products.
evidence: PyMuPDF word-coordinate extraction of E147 p25, cross-checked against a 2.5x-scale rendered image of the same page, reads the drawer height stack printed to the left of each cabinet illustration for every EA/EB/ED code that appears on the page.

Every code that could be decoded against its printed drawer-height stack matched the formula exactly: EA-7042(T) -> H700, 04 -> 4 drawers, config 2 -> stack 100/100T/150T/250T (4 rows). EA-7051(T) -> 5 drawers config 1 -> 5 rows. EA-7061(T) -> 6 drawers config 1 -> 6 rows. EA-10062(T) -> 6 drawers config 2 -> 6 rows (100/150T/150T/150T/150T/200T). EA-10073(T) -> 7 drawers config 3 -> 7 rows (75/75/100T/100T/150T/150T/250T). EA-10091(T) -> 9 drawers config 1 -> 9 rows (100 + eight 100T). EA-12052(T) -> 5 drawers config 2 -> 5 rows (200T x4 + 300T). EA-12071(T) -> 7 drawers config 1 -> 7 rows (150T x6 + 200T). EA-12074(T) -> 7 drawers config 4 -> 7 rows (100 + 100T x3 + 200T x2 + 300T).

A full-text regex search (pattern E[ABD]-\d{3,5}[A-Z]{0,2}) across every page of both TANKO Catalogue NO.E147.pdf (52pp) and TANKO_Catalogue_NO.E327.pdf (4pp) found that ONLY 9 distinct drawer-count/config combinations exist anywhere in either catalogue: H700 -> 042, 051, 061 (3 of the website's 8 dropdown values: 7041,7042,7051,7052,7053,7054,7061,7073). H1000 -> 062, 073, 091 (3 of: 10051,10052,10061,10062,10071,10072,10073,10091). H1200 -> 052, 071, 074 (3 of: 12051,12052,12071,12072,12073,12074,12081,12082). Mobile H700 (EA-7042M/EB-7042M, EA-7051M/EB-7051M, EA-7042MA/EB-7042MA) -> 3 of the ea-7m family's 8 dropdown values (7041,7042,7051,7052,7053,7054,7061,7081).

The remaining 5 of 8 values in every one of the ea-7/ea-10/ea-12/ea-7m website dropdowns (e.g. EA-10051, EA-10052, EA-10061, EA-10071, EA-10072) do NOT occur anywhere in either PDF. They cannot be confirmed from the source catalogues -- they are either unpublished/discontinued Tanko SKUs, or values the site generator invented to fill out a combinatorial matrix. They should be labelled 'not in the catalogue', not given an invented drawer stack.
drawer_code_verdict.what_differs_between_config_1_and_config: CONFIRMED: it is the drawer HEIGHT STACK (and therefore which individual drawers are standard vs T-type), not the drawer count. Example -- H1000, 6 drawers: config '062' (the only 6-drawer config found in the catalogue) stacks 100/150T/150T/150T/150T/200T. No 6-drawer config-1 (061) or config-3+ counterpart exists in the catalogue to compare directly, but the H700 3-drawer-count set (042 config2 vs the absence of 041/043 in catalogue) and the H1200 7-drawer set (071 config1 = 150T x6+200T, vs 074 config4 = 100+100Tx3+200Tx2+300T) both show unambiguously that different config digits at the SAME drawer count carry DIFFERENT height stacks and different standard/T-drawer placement, while W/D/H of the cabinet itself stays fixed for a given cabinet letter+height.
drawer_code_verdict.T_suffix_meaning: T marks the individual drawer built with a 100%-extension slide rated 200kg; the base (no-T) row is a 90%-extension slide rated 100kg. Confirmed by E147 p24 'Drawer Features' callout. The SKU-level (T) suffix, e.g. EA-7042T, denotes the cabinet variant where the marked rows use T-type slides; this is independent of drawer count/config.

_meta.note: From E147 p26 'CNC Tool Cabinet' matrix. Loading: 100kg/standard drawer, 200kg/T drawer, 1000kg whole-frame (static). Applies to the EA-10n/EA-10mn/EA-12n/EA-7mn website families (60 of the 90 cnc-tool SKUs) whose axes are Cabinet(EA/EB/ED) x Tool Holders(BT-30/BT-40/BT-50/HSK-40/HSK-63). This table is the ONLY source for holder capacity and is what must differentiate those 90 SKUs since they share only 5 distinct cabinet dimension values and have no on-page top material or load rating of their own.

cnc_website_matrix_application.note: Recommended per-SKU application for the 60 ea-10n/ea-10mn/ea-12n/ea-7mn website SKUs: dims/load are constant per family (see families above); holder qty = CNC_HOLDER_MATRIX.drawer_tray_qty[taper][cabinet_letter] + CNC_HOLDER_MATRIX.upper_tray_qty[taper][cabinet_letter].

__CNC_WEBSITE_FAMILY_NOTE__.family: How the 90 website cnc-tool SKUs map to the catalogue
__CNC_WEBSITE_FAMILY_NOTE__.note: docs/cnc-tool/ea-10n (CNC Tool Cabinet H1000, 15 variants), ea-10mn (Mobile CNC Tool Cabinet H1300, 15), ea-12n (CNC Tool Cabinet H1200, 15), ea-7mn (Mobile CNC Tool Cabinet H1000, 15) = 60 SKUs total, axes Cabinet(EA/EB/ED) x Tool Holders(BT-30/BT-40/BT-50/HSK-40/HSK-63). Catalogue page 26 gives only ONE literal cabinet code per height/mobility combo (e.g. EA-10031-22N) with a fixed 2-holder-type drawer-tray configuration baked into the -22N/-33N/-222N/-22MN/-33MN/-222MN suffix; it does NOT show all 5x3 = 15 individual taper/cabinet SKU codes per family literally in print. The per-taper HOLDER QTY differentiator (drawer tray + upper tray) is fully documented in CNC_HOLDER_MATRIX above and is valid to apply uniformly across the family regardless of the exact suffix on the literal catalogue SKU, since dimensions and load do not vary by taper. The remaining 30 cnc-tool SKUs (enr-12, ens-1, ens-3, san-33, san-36, san-36k; 5 variants each) are a DIFFERENT physical product line (CNC Trolley / CNC Tool Cabinet with Door) documented on pages 27-29 with their own literal model numbers and holder-qty tables -- see those SKUs below.
